**Changed**
- Added `server_thread_counts` telemetry to [measure_official_client_breakdown](</__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_official_client_breakdown:1>) so the tiny-base forced-cache probe now reports server thread counts alongside CPU time and request-path stats.
- Tested two Rust branches and discarded both:
  - lazy Rayon init in [src/db.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/db.rs:1): reduced forced-cache threads, but clean scored runs regressed.
  - fixed connection-worker / CPU-affinity path in [src/server.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/server.rs:1): slower on the tiny-base probe and later hung, so it was removed completely.
- Recorded the cycle in [research_notes.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/research_notes.md:1) and [campaign_journal.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/campaign_journal.md:1).

**Validation**
- `build_project`: passed.
- `run_correctness_test`: passed, recall `1.0000`.
- Clean quick `run_benchmark` samples on the kept default path: `11444.08` QPS and `10275.00` QPS, both valid.

Current score expectation is still no promotion this cycle; the best valid full score remains `12244.84`, well below the `22000` target. Next best move is to use the new thread telemetry to build a sharper reqwest/client-interlock probe, and if that still does not expose a believable transport win, pivot the Rust work back to a stronger ANN shortlist branch.

## Cycle 17

- Added a new experimental close-per-search transport path, exposed as local-only `VDB_CLOSE_AFTER_CACHED_SEARCH` in [src/server.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/server.rs:1) and as `--close-after-cached-search` in [measure_official_client_breakdown](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_official_client_breakdown:1), [measure_official_client_ceiling](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_official_client_ceiling:1), and the dummy harness at [.meta_codex/tools/dummy_ceiling/src/main.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/dummy_ceiling/src/main.rs:1).
- The first cut was invalid because it closed sockets without signaling `Connection: close`; that run collapsed to `3159.68 QPS` and `0.529` recall on the tiny-base real forced-cache probe. The branch was then repaired so the close mode rewrites cached responses with an explicit `Connection: close` header before the socket is dropped.
- The repaired experiment still lost by a huge margin. On the same tiny-base official-client breakdown, valid keepalive baseline was `9750.00 QPS`, while `--close-after-cached-search` reached only `1584.94 QPS` at `1.0000` recall. Server CPU jumped to about `2.75s`, and average cached-search `write_response` time rose to about `147 us`.
- Default scored-path behavior stayed intact after the new dormant knob landed. A clean serial [run_correctness_test](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/run_correctness_test:1) still passed at `1.0000` recall, and a clean serial quick [run_benchmark](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/run_benchmark:1) measured `11068.93 QPS`, also valid.
- Next cycle should not revisit per-response connection teardown. The better next move is a sharper local reqwest/client-interlock probe first. If that probe cannot expose a believable client-visible transport win, pivot the Rust work back toward a substantive ANN/index branch instead of more cache-path transport experiments.
